aurora-over-a-dead-world:
In humanity's last refuge, the flying island Aurora, the military and the [Kairas] are the only forces keeping human civilization alive as they descend into the [Horizon] in search of resources, ancient technology, and anything else that might ensure the survival of their species. In this devastated world, monsters born from fear emerge from humanity's own mistakes and from the technology created when people tampered with things they were never meant to touch.
Zenith, a former commander and war veteran, is demoted and assigned as the tutor of six troublesome students—girls far too powerful to be entrusted to just anyone and far too dangerous to ignore, as they have the potential to become some of humanity's greatest talents.

bastard-lord-i-can-change-class-at-will:
On a late-night drive to an unknown destination, he died in a car crash and awakened in a world centuries behind his own.
His new body belonged to a man who had already given up on life.
Weak, sickly, and treated as nothing more than a burden. Mocked by his own brother. Loathed by the woman he loved.
His wife had even betrayed him with his own father.
A life so miserable that its owner chose to end it all over another sunrise.
Then another soul took his place.
“What a pathetic ending. If I'm going to live this life, I'll take everything this world has to offer.”
Despite possessing talents meant for soldiers and knights, he was neither.
He was a greedy man.
A man willing to lie, manipulate, steal, and trample over anyone standing between him and what he desired.
And with a mysterious System guiding his every step, he had no intention of taking the safe path.
In a world ruled by kingdoms, monsters, and endless wars, the greatest threat was never the strongest warrior.
It was the man who wanted everything.
--------

beyond-the-script-the-extra-who-stole-th:
When a terminally ill young man awakens in the world of his favorite childhood game, he realizes he isn’t the protagonist, the destined hero, or even a major side character. Instead, he has become an extra—a disowned noble barely clinging to relevance in a world where strength determines everything. Worse, his fate in the game was to die an early, meaningless death.
Armed with only his knowledge of the game’s storyline and a common system that tracks his stats and skills, he is determined to survive. But mere survival isn’t enough. He remembers a hidden easter egg from a long-forgotten anime collaboration: the Mangekyō Sharingan—a power limited by game mechanics but unrestricted in reality.
With Kamui as his trump card, he walks the fine line between fate and freedom, seizing power from the shadows while avoiding suspicion. As the protagonist and his allies battle against demons and unravel the game’s grand destiny, he secretly builds his own strength—manipulating events, mastering forgotten arts, and even forging ties with villainous factions.
Will he remain a footnote in history, or will he carve his own legend in a world that was never meant to be his?

crimson-vale-academy:
Crimson Vale Academy—where reputation is currency, and failure is a stain you wear on your sleeve.
Behind gothic walls and spotless uniforms, students aren't just educated—they're measured, ranked, and pitted against each other in a brutal meritocracy. Privileges are earned, not given. The strong rise. The weak vanish.
Enter Kairon Vale, a transfer student marked Rank D—the bottom of the bottom. No badge. Just a stitched black fang, branding him as “Obsidian”—a warning to others.
In a system where points dictate your value, Obsidian-ranked students claw for every opportunity to ascend into the prestigious Golden or Platinum ranks—where comfort, power, and influence await. But for most, it’s a losing battle.
Yet Kairon isn’t here to fit in, impress, or play by their rules. Cold, calculating, and impossible to read, he watches the system… and waits. Because while the academy judges worth by numbers and names—he understands something deeper:
Everyone wears a mask. And every mask can be cracked.
Let the games begin.

The man coldly refused: “Miss Kendall, please have some self-respect.”

She decisively gave up and decided to marry another man.
On her wedding day, the man burst in and pinned her in the dressing room: “You dare marry someone else?”

The man's eyes turned red with fury. He gritted his teeth and sneered, “Fine. You wanted to be a research subject? Let's start now!”

the-civilization-system-save-rome:
The records never disappear. They only wait to be found.
Arthur Bennett expected to spend his life studying history.
He never expected to wake up inside it.

To save Rome, he may have to change history.

Collapse is not inevitable.
Yet.
